title: A campaign's ledger (saves/<campaign>/ledger.json)
description: The campaign ledger, the GM's memory, oldest first: improvisations by Claude or the user, GM secrets, rulings, threads, quests, timed events and session summaries (board/ledger.js). On the board each entry is a record ledger/<id>; players never see it. Saves stay private (saves/ is git-ignored).

by.description: who wrote it: Claude, or the user in the GM view

subjects.description: people, places and things it is about, for search

source.description: from the book, or invented at the table

addedBy.description: who invented an added detail: Claude, or the user (at the table or as a player)

status.description: threads, quests and timed events only

links.description: record paths: chat/<id>, replay/<id>, ledger/<id>, notes/<id>
